network_storage.if: NIC mapping churn and storage reusable-pool accesses really compete for one translation resource, while equal-cost legal page/layout/prepare controls and byte-rate pacing are available.
network_storage.testable_question: At the same useful-byte and in-flight budget, does page-locality/mapping-lifetime driven translation service pressure leave extra receiver completion waiting that byte-rate pacing alone fails to predict, after applicable strong simple controls?
network_storage.required_discrimination: Preserve payload/useful work; separate external protocol/media/CPU/map-unmap overhead from cache replacement or PTW service propagation. Static DDT projection cannot claim to reproduce strict F&S.
network_storage.adjacent_counterexample: Both translated paths do not share the limiting resource, or legitimate large-page/stable-pool preparation and ordinary pacing satisfy both progress objectives.

periodic_capture.if: Measured producer/consumer timing leaves finite slot-reuse margin and an irrevocable background copy overlaps actual frame readiness in the same enabled translation service.
periodic_capture.testable_question: Does residual translation service inside already-published work exceed capture buffer reuse margin, so an ordinary future-copy gate is too late even with legal ring preparation and bounded pieces?
periodic_capture.required_discrimination: Use actual queued buffer ownership, negotiated bytes and successful frame events; compare legal pre-publication priority/feedback/chunking and count costs.
periodic_capture.adjacent_counterexample: Legal preparation, page sizes and bounded ordinary admission keep capture/consumer within actual margin and still finish background.
